title: stipa pennata var. okensis
intro: Stipa pennata var. okensis, commonly known as  Kazakh feather grass or  Mongolian feather grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Stipa pennata var. okensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Stipa pennata var. okensis for medicinal purposes.
